verdict.rationale: The SDK automatically writes session history to disk, and returning to a session restores full prior context: files read, analysis done, decisions made. A SessionStore adapter can mirror transcripts to your own database or object store so another host can resume the session, and the hosting docs cover session persistence for production. missing for 10: explicit documentation of crash-recovery semantics (e.g. resuming mid-turn or mid-tool-call rather than at conversation-history granularity), checkpointing of non-transcript state such as the working directory or shell, and independent or hands-on corroboration of resume after a crash.
